title: PRD: Telemetry-driven Endpoint Suite (chat/completions/embeddings/rerank) + Launch Checklist
creator: Aisha K. Patel
description: Summary: This PRD defines the scope, success metrics, and operational playbook to launch a unified hosted endpoint suite that exposes chat, completions, embeddings, and rerank capabilities with telemetry-driven acceptance and rollout controls. Goal: Ship an opinionated default configuration and staged rollout that guarantees production SLOs while enabling rapid experimentation and cost controls. Key outcomes: (1) clear behavioral and performance acceptance gates backed by live telemetry; (2) a deterministic canary and rollout plan with rollback hooks; (3) automated checks (QA + evals) for quality regressions across generation and embedding tasks; (4) an operator checklist and runbook integrated into Console dashboards.
scope: In scope: hosted API endpoints for chat, completions, embeddings, rerank; telemetry collection and dashboards; acceptance gates (quality + perf); canary rollout config and feature flags; automated evals and blocking checks. Out of scope: Dedicated/Private deployment automation, SDK language bindings changes beyond minimal surface parity, major model architecture changes (model onboarding handled separately).
goals: P95 generation latency <= 200ms for short prompts (<=128 tokens) on standard hosted tier
End-to-end error rate <= 0.2% (5xx + malformed responses) during canary and steady state
Embedding quality regressions: no more than 2% relative drop vs baseline on held-out similarity tests
Rerank correctness: top-1 agreement >= 95% with current baseline on benchmark set
Operational observability: per-route token cost, P50/P95/P99 latency, KV cache hit rate, batching efficiency available in Console
non_goals: Changing model families or introducing new quantization defaults
Large SDK refactors or breaking API surface changes
acceptance_criteria: Functional: chat/completions/embeddings/rerank endpoints accept existing API parameters and return schema-compliant responses for canonical cases
Quality: automated eval suite (generation+embedding+rerk) passes with no regression beyond tolerances defined in goals
Performance: benchmark harness shows measured P95 latency and throughput meeting targets under representative traffic patterns
Reliability: end-to-end 5xx rate <= 0.2% under synthetic and shadow traffic for 72h
Observability: Console dashboards surfaced with token-level cost and route breakdowns, and alerting rules created for latency/error/cost anomalies
Security & Compliance: audit logs enabled, KMS integration validated for request metadata where required
Rollout gating: canary run of 1% traffic for 24h with automated guardrails (if any guardrail tripped, auto-hold and notify SRE/PM)
launch_checklist: Finalize API behavioral spec document and public README (link in docs_links)
Merge API compatibility tests and contract tests to main; run across staging models
Deploy canary config: 1% traffic, feature flag toggled, canary health monitors enabled
Run 24h canary with synthetic and shadow traffic; verify acceptance criteria are met
Promote to gradual rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 24h observation windows between steps
Create Console dashboards: per-route latency percentiles, error breakdown, KV cache hit rates, batching metrics
Create alerts and pager thresholds: P95 latency, 5xx rate, token-cost spike >20%
Publish runbook: rollback steps, how to pin model variants, how to restrict traffic to previous runtime
Coordinate docs release and SDK quickstart snippets (minimal verification only)
Post-launch 7-day quality sweep: run eval suite daily and report regressions to PM/ML research
test_plan: 1) Contract tests: run the full API contract suite on staging models and runtimes. 2) Load tests: synthetic traffic with realistic token distribution and batching patterns to validate throughput and autoscaling behavior. 3) Shadow traffic: send 10% of production traffic to new endpoint without affecting responses; compare logs and metrics. 4) Automated evals: generation prompts, embedding similarity battery, and rerank benchmarks run in CI with clear tolerances. 5) Manual validation: Solutions engineering to run smoke tests with 5 customers. Results and artifacts linked in docs_links.
metrics_and_telemetry: Core metrics: token_count, tokens_per_request, request_latency_p50_p95_p99, request_error_rate_5xx, kv_cache_hit_rate, batch_size_distribution, per_route_token_cost, model_variant_used. Telemetry retention: perf metrics 90d, audit logs 365d (where configured). Dashboards: canary overview, cost delta, quality regression panel connected to eval-suite outputs.
rollout_plan: Stage 0: Internal preview for 3 internal teams (SEs, Solutions, Platform) for 3 days. Stage 1: Canary 1% production traffic for 24h. Stage 2: Gradual rollout 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 24h hold. Gate logic: any of the following trips gate and auto-hold rollout: P95 latency increases >30% vs baseline, 5xx rate >0.5% sustained for 10m, embedding quality regression >2% on daily evals, token-cost increase >25% without countervailing latency improvement. Escalation path: notify on-call SRE -> Eng lead -> PM -> ML research within 15 minutes of gate trip.
